metadata.description: The Christmas Lighthouse is the festive Christmas park of Alexandroupoli featuring the ice rink, charity parade, interactive games, workshops and holiday events for all ages.

hero.title: The magic of Christmas under the lighthouse of Alexandroupolis

section-header.title: Our main highlights
section-header.description: From graceful skating to festive celebrations, our magical experiences brings the holiday spirit to life for visitors of all ages. Discover the enclosed ice rink, join our heartwarming Christmas parade, and enjoy a full season of interactive events with Santa, elves, mascots, and more.

ice-rink-card.title: Enclosed ice rink
ice-rink-card.description: Glide across our fully enclosed ice rink, surrounded shimmering lights, festive décor, and the sound of holiday music filling the air.

parade-card.title: Christmas parade
parade-card.description: Celebrate the season with Santa, lively elves, sparkling costumes, and captivating performances, all dedicated to raising funds for children and families in need.

events-card.title: Interactive events
events-card.description: Dive into a full lineup of festive activities—live storytelling, creative workshops, holiday crafts, face painting, and surprises for all ages.

section-header.title: About The Christmas Lighthouse
section-header.description: Located at the Port of Alexandroupoli, The Christmas Lighthouse is a festive Christmas park filled with lights, music, and seasonal attractions for visitors of all ages.

info-card.title: Park Information
info-card.description: Set at the heart of the city’s port, the park transforms the waterfront into a magical Christmas destination.

zone-2.entry-2: Exception: on Friday, January 8, 2027 the park opens at 18:00

location.title: Location
location.description: Port of Alexandroupoli, beneath the Lighthouse

section-header.title: Christmas parade
section-header.description: The Christmas parade of the Municipality of Alexandroupoli, in collaboration with The Christmas Lighthouse, marks the opening of the park. Grab your Christmas hat and march with Santa, his elf and all our favourite characters!

info-card.title: Friday, December 4, 2026 — 17:30
info-card.subtitle: The Christmas Lighthouse opens its doors with a Christmas parade!
info-card.description: Organised by the <axd>Municipality of Alexandroupoli</axd> in collaboration with The Christmas Lighthouse. Joining us: Santa with his elf, Olaf, the Minion, Mickey, Minnie, Pikachu, T-Rex, our living Christmas tree, the Panda, and the Grinch. 3,000 Christmas hats will be handed out at schools — bring yours and come march with us!

section-header.title: Christmas parade
section-header.description: The Christmas parade of the Municipality of Alexandroupoli, in collaboration with The Christmas Lighthouse, opened this year’s season with Santa, his elf and all our favourite characters.

info-card.title: Friday, December 4, 2026 — 17:30
info-card.subtitle: Thank you to everyone who marched with us!
info-card.description: Organised by the <axd>Municipality of Alexandroupoli</axd> in collaboration with The Christmas Lighthouse, the Christmas parade marked the opening of the park. See you at next year’s parade!

section-header.title: Daily Christmas activities
section-header.description: Discover the magical surprises waiting for you every day. Each date includes a morning activity and an afternoon event, giving families two unique moments of festive fun throughout the season.

4/12.afternoon: The Christmas Lighthouse opens its doors! At 17:30, the Christmas parade of the Municipality of Alexandroupoli, in collaboration with The Christmas Lighthouse, takes to the streets! Joining us: Santa with his elf, Olaf, the Minion, Mickey, Minnie, Pikachu, T-Rex, our living Christmas tree, the Panda, and the Grinch. 3,000 Christmas hats will be handed out at schools — grab yours and come march with us!

5/12.afternoon: Who tells the best Christmas stories? Santa, of course!

6/12.morning: Come to the main stage for experiments and games with the elf and Minnie Mouse!
6/12.afternoon: Elf games on the main stage!

12/12.morning: Rudolph, where are you? Santa is looking for you!
12/12.afternoon: Santa’s list is waiting at his little house! Make sure you’re on it!

13/12.morning: Main stage: What on earth is a panda bear doing here?
13/12.afternoon: Main stage: Come make origami gnomes with the elves!

19/12.morning: Travels around the world with Santa!
19/12.afternoon: Have you written your Christmas wish? Santa can’t wait to read it!

20/12.morning: A Pokémon in our park! Where has it been hiding all this time?
20/12.afternoon: Santa, how do you get down the chimneys? Will you tell us the secret?

24/12.morning: The reindeer are struggling to pull the sleigh full of gifts… Can you help Santa?
24/12.afternoon: The Grinch is going to “steal” Christmas! Or is he?

25/12.morning: A very, very tall little angel is coming to The Christmas Lighthouse!
25/12.afternoon: Games and lots of dancing with our little elf!

26/12.afternoon: Dear Santa, tell us the story of Christmas!

27/12.morning: Christmas game on the main stage with our elf!
27/12.afternoon: Dear Santa, this year I want…

28/12.morning: A Minion took our bananas! What’s going on here?
28/12.afternoon: Main stage: Elf science… Join the elves’ workshop!

29/12.morning: Where did the goblins hide our toys? Help the elves!
29/12.afternoon: Candy cane challenge: Join the elves’ game!

30/12.morning: Elves vs. goblins: Which team will win?
30/12.afternoon: Olaf is coming to The Christmas Lighthouse!

31/12.morning: Santa is putting the finishing touches on our gifts!
31/12.afternoon: Elf mix-ups before the New Year!

1/1.morning: Happy New Year from The Christmas Lighthouse! Come have a great time with us!
1/1.afternoon: Did Santa manage to deliver all the gifts after all?

2/1.morning: Santa is leaving for the North Pole soon!
2/1.afternoon: Have a good trip, Santa! See you next year!
